'''2020 Match Play Championship''' was the Players Committee match-play championship on GEMP. [[Hayes Hunter]] finished 1st in the Final Four.<ref name="pc">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2020-match-play-championships/ starwarsccg.org], starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013162034/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2020-match-play-championships.html Internet Archive].</ref> The event was planned for New Brunswick, New Jersey, on 17–19 April 2020, with 64 places.<ref name="slack-mpc20-nj">Star Wars CCG Slack, #announcements, Players Committee Twitter feed (@swccg), 1 and 5 March 2020: “The annual Star Wars CCG Match Play Championship is about 1.5 months away. Half of the 64 spots have been claimed.”; “debating about attending the Match Play Championships in New Brunswick, NJ from April 17 - 19th?”</ref> On 24 March 2020 the [[Players Committee]] announced that it would be played entirely on [[GEMP]] on the original dates, with the same prize pool.<ref name="slack-mpc20-gemp">Star Wars CCG Slack, #announcements, Players Committee Twitter feed (@swccg), 24 March 2020: “Good news everyone! The 2020 MPC will take place after all, on the originally scheduled dates (4/18-4/19). The tournament will be played entirely on GEMP. Prize pool will remain the same & you can now compete no matter where you live!”</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' GEMP
* '''Dates:''' 18–19 and 25 April 2020<ref name="slack-mpc20-dates">Star Wars CCG Slack, #announcements, Players Committee Twitter feed (@swccg), 24 March and 21 April 2020: “The 2020 MPC will take place after all, on the originally scheduled dates (4/18-4/19). The tournament will be played entirely on GEMP.”; “The Final Four round of the 2020 MPC will commence at 12:00pm EDT this Saturday, 4/25.”</ref>

The quarterfinals on 19 April 2020 were (6) [[Jarad Konsker]] against (9) [[Matt Scott]], (6) [[Kyle Krueger]] against (9) [[Wayne Cullen]], (1) [[Justin Desai]] against (6) [[Matt Wadden]], and (2) [[Steve Baroni]] against (5) [[Conor Britain]].<ref name="slack-mpc20-qf">Star Wars CCG Slack, #announcements, Players Committee Twitter feed (@swccg), 19 April 2020: “(6) Jarad Konsker vs. (9) Matt Scott … (6) Kyle Krueger vs. (9) Wayne Cullen … (1) Justin Desai vs. (6) Matt Wadden”; “The last quarterfinal match, (2) Steve Baroni vs. (5) Connor Britain is starting NOW”</ref> The Final Four on 25 April 2020 paired (1) [[Hayes Hunter]] with (6) Kyle Krueger and (6) Matt Wadden with (6) Jarad Konsker.<ref name="slack-mpc20-f4">Star Wars CCG Slack, #announcements, Players Committee Twitter feed (@swccg), 21 April 2020: “The Final Four round of the 2020 MPC will commence at 12:00pm EDT this Saturday, 4/25. (1) H Hunter v (6) K Krueger & (6) M Wadden v (6) J Konsker are the matchups.”</ref>
